candidates.change_summary: Remove the overflow check by deleting the require statement that ensures balance and msg.value sum does not overflow.
Change the unlock time assignment to always use block.timestamp, ignoring the _unlockTime parameter.
Insert early return statement before state changes, causing function to be a no-op.
Change balance increment to a fixed large constant, ignoring msg.value.
Remove the unlock time condition so Collect succeeds even before unlockTime.
Remove the MinSum balance check so Collect succeeds below the minimum threshold.
Replace `>=` with `>` in balance check against `_am` to require strictly greater balance.
Replace `>` with `>=` on the unlock time condition so Collect succeeds exactly at unlockTime.
Delete the balance update `acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am);` so balance is never deducted.
Insert `require(msg.sender == tx.origin);` at the beginning of Collect to restrict to non-contract callers.
